propositions: FixedBench shows 35-65% over-action (plans adding mechanisms without demonstrating need), but plan-review gate lacks a necessity criterion to flag this gap
Bug tickets currently bypass plan-review substantively via short-circuit to exempt-PASS (verified on bug 5886: REVIEW_RESULT={runner:exempt, llm_calls:0}), receiving no advisory or substantive review
A new pass-1 advisory criterion 'necessity' must flag plans that do not motivate or reproduce the change, distinct from asserted-capability (which checks existing implementations)
The bug review tier must replace bare exempt-PASS with a lightweight advisory tier: DET floor plus necessity probe only, never blocking a bug
Both pieces must ship advisory (never block) and auto-flow into the standing recorder for effectiveness monitoring prior to any advisory->blocking promotion decision
